_comment: Classes used in ng-zorro templates that antd v6 CSS does not style. `space` entries are temporary: remove each one once the component's template is aligned with antd v6. Categories: antd-emits (antd's own component emits it, v6 CSS never styles it); patch-motion (ng-zorro motion class styled by the component's style/v6/patch.css); nz-only (ng-zorro-only class with no antd counterpart: styled by the component's style/v6/patch.css, or an unstyled runtime state hook that no stylesheet targets — the component's own comment says which); v4-compat (v4 class kept next to its v6 replacement while v4 is the default; removable then); v4-compat (patch hook) (v4 class that style/v6/patch.css selects, so removing it needs a patch rewrite); scan-artefact (a literal the static scan picks up but that is never rendered as a class).
_anchor_comment: v4-compat (patch hook): ant-anchor-ink-ball (style/v6/patch.css mirrors v6's ink geometry -- position, display toggle, width, colour -- onto this element, since ng-zorro moves the ball rather than the rail; no single-name v6 replacement), ant-anchor-ink-ball-visible (replacement: ant-anchor-ink-visible, added alongside on the same element by anchor.component.ts's setVisible; style/v6/patch.css selects both classes for the same display toggle). ant-affix is NOT listed here even though it is rendered by the composed nz-affix and not by anchor's own template: rendering Anchor with the default affix=true also extracts Affix's own `.ant-affix{position:fixed;...}` rule under Anchor's style module (publish/anchor/style/v6/index.css), so manifest.json's anchor entry already carries the class directly -- styledClassesFor credits it without a renderedPrefixes entry, and allowlisting it as pending-map would make class-coverage.spec's stale-entry check fail.
_steps_comment: antd-emits: ant-steps-item-disabled (rc-steps `Step.js` adds `${itemCls}-disabled` for `disabled === true`; v6 CSS has no rule for it, a disabled step is simply not clickable). v4-compat: ant-steps-item-container (replacement: ant-steps-item-wrapper, on the same element), ant-steps-item-tail (replacement: ant-steps-item-rail plus ant-steps-item-rail-<next step's status>, on the same element), ant-steps-label-horizontal / ant-steps-label-vertical (replacement: ant-steps-title-horizontal / ant-steps-title-vertical on the root, resolved as antd's mergedTitlePlacement), ant-steps-next-error (no v6 counterpart: the rail before an error step takes ant-steps-item-rail-error instead). v4-compat (patch hook): ant-steps-item-description (antd's body slot is ant-steps-item-content, a name ng-zorro's section already carries for v4, so style/v6/patch.css mirrors the body rules onto the description), ant-steps-progress-icon (style/v6/patch.css gives it the box of antd's ant-steps-item-progress-icon-svg; ng-zorro composes nz-progress there instead of antd's own SVG), ant-steps-icon / ant-steps-icon-dot (inner spans ng-zorro keeps inside ant-steps-item-icon; style/v6/patch.css gives them the dot's hit area so a custom nzProgressDot template stays hoverable). Not emitted, so not listed: ant-steps-item-header (v4 pairs ant-steps-item-content > ant-steps-item-title, so no header element is inserted; style/v6/patch.css mirrors the header rules onto the title), ant-steps-item-icon-dot / -item-icon-dot-custom (antd 6.6.5 never emits them), ant-steps-item-progress-icon-* (antd's own SVG ring), and ant-steps-inline / -panel / -panel-arrow / -outlined / -ellipsis / -item-ellipsis / -max-count / -horizontal-alternate (no ng-zorro input; docs/v6-api-gaps.md).
_timeline_comment: scan-artefact: ant-cmp-steps-item-icon-dot-color (the custom property in `timeline-item.component.ts`'s `[style.--ant-cmp-steps-item-icon-dot-color]` binding, antd's inline variable for a custom dot colour; never a class). v4-compat: ant-timeline-alternate (replacement: ant-timeline-layout-alternate on the same root), ant-timeline-label (replacement: ant-timeline-layout-alternate, set as antd's `layoutAlternate` for labelled items too), ant-timeline-right (replacement: ant-timeline-item-placement-end on each item), ant-timeline-pending, ant-timeline-reverse (no v6 counterpart: antd marks only the pending node, `-item-process`, and expresses the order through each rail's status), ant-timeline-item-head (replacement: ant-timeline-item-icon, same element), ant-timeline-item-head-blue/-green/-red/-gray (replacement: ant-timeline-item-color-<colour> on the item, where antd's `useItems.js` puts it; a custom colour is the inline `--ant-cmp-steps-item-icon-dot-color` on the item), ant-timeline-item-head-custom (replacement: ant-timeline-item-custom on the item, rc-steps `Step.js`'s `${itemCls}-custom` for an icon), ant-timeline-item-label (replacement: ant-timeline-item-header plus ant-timeline-item-title, same element), ant-timeline-item-left / ant-timeline-item-right (replacement: ant-timeline-item-placement-start / -end, same element), ant-timeline-item-last (replacement: ant-timeline-item-active on the last node shown, whose tail carries no ant-timeline-item-rail), ant-timeline-item-pending (replacement: ant-timeline-item-process plus ant-timeline-item-custom, same element). v4-compat (patch hook): ant-timeline-item-tail (replacement: ant-timeline-item-rail plus -item-rail-<status> on every node but the last shown; style/v6/patch.css hides a tail without -item-rail, since antd renders no rail there). Not emitted: ant-timeline-item-section (v4 pairs `.ant-timeline-item-last > .ant-timeline-item-tail` and `> .ant-timeline-item-content`, so no section element is inserted; style/v6/patch.css mirrors the section's box onto the content and its alternate flex row onto the item), ant-timeline-item-icon-dot / -item-icon-dot-custom (styled by Steps' copied CSS but never emitted by antd 6.6.5 or @rc-component/steps), ant-timeline-horizontal, ant-timeline-filled, ant-timeline-item-subtitle and Steps' other copied modes (-small, -navigation, -inline, -panel, -with-progress, -ellipsis, -max-count, -title-vertical, -horizontal-alternate; no ng-zorro input, docs/v6-api-gaps.md).
_button_comment: button's entries are permanent, not pending alignment: antd v6's own React Button emits ant-btn-color-link and the legacy ant-btn-{default,dashed,link,text,dangerous,rtl} type/danger/rtl classes for backward compatibility, but its v6 CSS never styles them (verified against node_modules/antd/es/button/style). class-coverage.spec.ts pins this exact set so it can't silently grow. Button's compact-item classes (ant-btn-compact-first-item/-last-item) are not listed here: the per-directory audit (styledClassesFor) credits them from space's own manifest, since antd generates every component's compact rules once in Space's extraction (genCompactItemStyle).
_calendar_comment: calendar's header renders genuine nz-select (year/month) and nz-radio-button (month/year mode switch) components; every ant-select-*/ant-radio-button-* class their demos render is explained by select's and radio's own `_select_comment`/`_radio_comment`, and `allowlistFor` credits calendar with each owner's entries for its `renderedPrefixes` (`ant-select`, `ant-radio`), so calendar's own allowlist is empty.
_card_comment: v4-compat: ant-card-meta-detail (replacement: ant-card-meta-section, added alongside on the same div — antd v6's CardMeta.js renders the title+description wrapper as `${metaPrefixCls}-section`, not `-detail`; compiled v4 CSS still styles .ant-card-meta-detail and no `.ant-card-meta-section` rule exists in v4).
_cascader_comment: antd-emits: -rtl (@rc-component/cascader OptionList/List.js's own `${mergedPrefixCls}-rtl` on the menus wrapper; v6 CSS styles only -dropdown-rtl on the dropdown root, verified against node_modules/@rc-component/cascader/lib/OptionList/List.js). v4-compat: -menu-item-expanded (v4-only always-on class the option component's host binds; @rc-component/cascader's own Column.js only ever emits -menu-item-expand, never -expanded; no v6 counterpart), -menus-hidden (ng-zorro's own collapse-animation hook on .ant-cascader-menus while closed; List.js never emits it, no v6 counterpart), -picker-arrow-expand (ng-zorro's own rotate hook on the suffix icon; antd v6 has no per-cascader arrow class at all, no v6 counterpart). v4-compat (patch hook): -checkbox-inner (@rc-component/cascader's own OptionList/Checkbox.js draws the box directly on the bare `<span class="ant-cascader-checkbox">` it renders, with no inner span, same shape as checkbox/radio/tree; style/v6/patch.css mirrors those rules onto -inner with cascader's own prefix, scoped under .ant-cascader-dropdown to match v6's own specificity). The ant-select-* classes cascader's demos render (its root carries the bare `ant-select` class and reuses select's nz-select-search/nz-select-clear/nz-select-placeholder subcomponents) are not repeated here: select's own `_select_comment` already explains every one of them, and `allowlistFor` credits cascader with select's entries for the `ant-select` prefix.
_notification_comment: antd-emits: -close-icon (on the close anticon, PurePanel.js; v6 styles only -notice-close). v4-compat: -notice-content (next to -notice-wrapper), -notice-message (next to -notice-title), -notice-btn (next to -notice-actions), -notice-close-x (inner close span). v4-compat (patch hook): -notice-with-icon (next to -notice-section; the patch indents the text of notices with an icon). patch-motion: -fade-enter, -fade-leave.
_message_comment: v4-compat: -notice-content (next to -notice-wrapper), -{success,info,warning,error,loading} (runtime type class on -custom-content; v6 colours -notice-icon-{type} instead). v4-compat (patch hook): -custom-content (parent of icon and title; v4's `.ant-message .anticon` colour rules need it and the patch gives it v6's flex row). patch-motion: -move-up-enter, -move-up-leave.
_input_comment: antd-emits: -affix-wrapper-readonly (BaseInput.js sets it on the affix wrapper unconditionally; v6 CSS never styles it), -password (Password.js's wrapper className; v6 styles only the -password-icon it contains), -search-with-button (Search.js emits `${prefixCls}-with-button` on its root whenever an enter button is configured; v6 has no CSS for it, only for the button's own -search-btn[-filled] classes), -wrapper (rc-component/input's BaseInput.js still concatenates `${prefixCls}-wrapper` onto its group span alongside -group; confirmed by dumping antd's own addon demo — v6 CSS never styles it). v4-compat: -affix-wrapper-outlined (v4's affix wrapper variant lookup uses this prefix; v6's own variant rule targets the bare `ant-input-outlined` class added alongside it — -filled/-borderless/-underlined are the same shape but never render in the current demos, so they stay unlisted until a demo exercises them), -affix-wrapper-status-error/-warning (kept for the default v4 stylesheet, which keys the affix wrapper's status border off this prefix; v6's own status rule targets the bare `ant-input-status-error/-warning` classes added alongside it), -affix-wrapper-textarea-with-clear-btn (v4's textarea clear-button spacing hook; v6's equivalent spacing rule keys off `ant-input-textarea-affix-wrapper.ant-input-affix-wrapper`, added alongside it, so the patch no longer needs to select this class), -focused (v4-only; v6 uses -affix-wrapper-focused instead), -search-button (ng-zorro's own button element class, kept next to v6's -search-btn).
_input-number_comment: antd-emits: -in-form-item (InternalInputNumber's className builder sets `${prefixCls}-in-form-item` from FormItemInputContext unconditionally; v6 CSS never styles it). v4-compat (replacement named — a v6 class was added alongside these in this diff): -handler, -handler-down[-disabled], -handler-up[-disabled] (kept next to the new -action/-action-{up,down}[-disabled] classes), -group-addon (kept next to the new -addon class). v4-compat (no v6 counterpart at all): -handler-down-inner, -handler-up-inner (RcInputNumber's StepHandler only renders its own -action-{up,down}-inner span when no custom icon is passed, and antd always passes one, so no v6 markup ever needs this class), -group, -group-wrapper, -group-wrapper-rtl, -wrapper, -input-wrap (v6's InputNumber never wraps prefix/suffix or legacy addonBefore/After in this nested wrapper/group/input-wrap structure at all — RcInputNumber renders `-prefix`/`-suffix`/`<input>` as direct children of the single root div, and legacy addons render through Space.Compact + bare `-addon` spans around the root). v4-compat (patch hook — style/v6/patch.css selects these to mirror antd's `.ant-input-affix-wrapper`/`.ant-input-outlined`/legacy `.ant-input-group*` rules onto the ant-input-number-* names, since v6 has no rule of its own for any of them): -affix-wrapper (bare, unqualified; `components/input-number/style/v6/patch.css:9` selects `.ant-input-number-affix-wrapper` directly, since RcInputNumber's affix wrapper element has no v6 CSS at all beyond its `-lg`/`-sm` padding variants), -affix-wrapper-outlined, -affix-wrapper-disabled, -affix-wrapper-focused, -affix-wrapper-status-error, -affix-wrapper-status-warning, -affix-wrapper-rtl, -group-wrapper-outlined (-filled/-borderless/-underlined and -group-wrapper-status-error/-warning are the same shape but never render in the current demos, so they stay unlisted and un-patched until a demo exercises them). nz-only (unstyled runtime state hook that no stylesheet, v4 or v6 patch, targets): -affix-wrapper-readonly.
_space_comment: antd-emits: -horizontal (antd's own Space still renders `${prefixCls}-${orientation}` for the horizontal default, verified against a live antd render; v6 CSS has no rule for it since horizontal needs no styling), -item-separator (Space.Item's own hook class; v6 CSS defines no rule for it either, since the separator's appearance comes from the ReactNode passed in, not from CSS). v4-compat: -split (superseded by -item-separator, the antd v6 name for the separator element, kept next to it for v4 rendering).
_skeleton_comment: antd-emits: -avatar-square, -button-square (shape classes v6 CSS never styles). v4-compat: -content (next to -section).
_spin_comment: v4-compat: -show-text (root flag when nzTip is set), -text (next to -description). v4-compat (patch hook): -nested-loading, -blur (the patch mirrors v6's -section and -spinning rules onto them).
_statistic_comment: antd-emits: -content-value-int, -content-value-decimal (`Number.js`'s `StatisticNumber` emits these exact class names on the digit/decimal spans; v6 CSS styles only their ancestor `.ant-statistic-content-value`, so the split spans inherit colour/size with no rule of their own), -rtl (`Statistic.js` sets `${prefixCls}-rtl` from `direction === 'rtl'`; v6 CSS has no dedicated rtl rule for statistic, the class is a plain state hook). The ant-skeleton-content class statistic's loading-state nz-skeleton renders is not repeated here: skeleton's own `_skeleton_comment` already explains it, and `allowlistFor` credits statistic with skeleton's entries for the `ant-skeleton` prefix.
_collapse_comment: antd-emits: -extra (@rc-component/collapse Panel.js's ifExtraExist && createElement('div', {className: prefixCls + '-extra'}); v6 CSS has no rule for it), -icon-placement-start (Collapse.js's prefixCls + '-icon-placement-' + mergedPlacement, with mergedPlacement defaulting to 'start'; v6 CSS only has a rule for the -end variant since start needs no repositioning -- the class name itself is unchanged from v4, contrary to a name guess of -icon-position-*), -item-active (Panel.js's collapsePanelClassNames clsx(prefixCls + '-item', {item-active: isActive}); v6 CSS has no dedicated rule, the active look comes from the inner .ant-collapse-panel/.ant-collapse-body rules), -no-arrow (CollapsePanel.js's no-arrow class when !showArrow; no v6 rule), -panel-active (PanelContent.js's clsx(prefixCls + '-panel', {panel-active: isActive}) -- still emitted by antd 6.6.5 exactly as v4, not dropped in favour of -item-active; v6 CSS styles only the bare .ant-collapse-panel selector, so -active itself carries no rule).
_rate_comment: nz-only: -star-active, -star-focused, -star-zero (runtime state hooks on the hovered/focused/unfilled star from `updateStarStyle`; no stylesheet, v4 or v6, styles them — kept because removing them from the rendered DOM is a consumer-visible change, and `rate-v6.spec.ts` asserts `-star-zero`). v4-compat: ant-rate-text (the label span next to the stars in the clear and text demos; v4 gives it `margin: 0 8px`, no v6 counterpart, antd's demos use a plain span).
_switch_comment: nz-only: -click-animating-node (the wave-effect node `nz-wave` renders on click; a v4-only ripple, no v6 stylesheet targets it since v6 Switch has no click ripple).
_table_comment: antd-emits: ant-table-fixed-column, ant-table-fixed-header (`@rc-component/table/es/Table.js`'s root `clsx` sets both from `fixColumn`/`fixHeader`, matching `table.component.ts`'s existing `[class.ant-table-fixed-column]`/`[class.ant-table-fixed-header]`; grepping `node_modules/antd/es/table/style/*.js` for either name finds no selector - v6 draws the same thing off `ant-table-scroll-horizontal` and the `ant-table-header`/`ant-table-sticky-holder` structure instead), ant-table-rtl (same `Table.js` root `clsx`, `direction === 'rtl'`; v6's `rtl.js` only styles `.ant-table-wrapper-rtl`, which `table.component.ts` already emits separately on the wrapper), ant-table-row-expand-icon-expanded (`antd/es/table/ExpandIcon.js`'s `renderExpandIcon` always emits one of `-expanded`/`-collapsed`/`-spaced`; `node_modules/antd/es/table/style/expand.js` has specific rotate rules for `-collapsed` and `-spaced` but none for `-expanded` - the expanded look is the base rule's default rotation, so the class carries no CSS either way), ant-table-column-sorter-full (`node_modules/antd/es/table/hooks/useSorter.js:100-101` adds it to the sorter wrapper whenever both the up and down nodes exist, matching `sorters.component.ts`'s existing binding; no selector for it in `style/sorter.js`). v4-compat (patch hook): ant-table-cell-fix-left-last (replacement: the real v6 shadow is ALSO driven by `ant-table-cell-fix-start-shadow`/`-start-shadow-show`, added to the same element; this v4 name is no longer emitted by current antd at all, but stays a patch hook because `table-inner-scroll.component.ts`'s `setScrollPositionClassName` queries it by this exact selector to find the cell to toggle `-start-shadow-show` on, and `style/v6/patch.css`'s `.ant-table-custom-column .ant-table-fixed tr .ant-table-cell-fix-left-last` rule also selects it). v4-compat: ant-table-has-fix-left, ant-table-has-fix-right (replacement: ant-table-has-fix-start/-end, added alongside on `table.component.ts`'s root - current antd only ever emits the `-start`/`-end` pair), ant-table-middle (replacement: ant-table-medium, added alongside - antd's own `InternalTable.js:475` only ever emits `-medium`, never `-middle`), ant-table-ping-left, ant-table-ping-right (no 1:1 replacement name; v4's own shadow mechanism, now also driving the real v6 classes `ant-table-fix-start/-end-shadow-show` and `ant-table-cell-fix-start/-end-shadow-show` from the same scroll-position check in `table-inner-scroll.component.ts` - current antd computes the same scroll-edge state internally without exposing a `-ping-*` class at all), ant-table-pagination-right (replacement: ant-table-pagination-end, added alongside - this name is ng-zorro's own, never built from antd source; `style/pagination.js` only defines `-start`/`-center`/`-end`). nz-only: ant-table-custom-column, ant-table-filter-open, ant-table-measure-now (ng-zorro-only hooks with no antd source at all - `nzCustomColumn`'s column manager, the filter-trigger's own open-state marker, and the measure row, which antd itself names `ant-table-measure-row` and does not style either; `ant-table-custom-column`'s layout is instead styled by `style/v6/patch.css`), ant-table-selection-down, ant-table-selection-menu, ant-table-selection-select-all-custom (ng-zorro's own hook classes around the row-selection "select all" dropdown; `node_modules/antd/es/table/hooks/useSelection.js` renders the same dropdown+icon without any of the three - its only own class there is `-selection-extra`, which ng-zorro already emits and v6 styles). ant-table-cell-with-append (`@rc-component/table/es/Cell/index.js:152` emits it whenever the cell has an appended expand icon/indent, matching `td-addon.component.ts`'s existing binding; no selector for it anywhere in `node_modules/antd/es/table/style/*.js`). v4-compat (patch hook): ant-table-fixed (`table-content.component.ts`'s own `[class.ant-table-fixed]` on the inner `<table>`, a v4-only width hook; current antd sets table-layout:fixed via inline `tableLayout` on the table style and a DIFFERENT class, `-layout-fixed`, on the root `.ant-table` div, not the inner table - no v6 rule targets `.ant-table-fixed` on a `<table>` element, and the inline `table-layout` style ng-zorro already sets achieves the same layout under either theme. Stays a patch hook because `style/v6/patch.css`'s `.ant-table-custom-column .ant-table-fixed tr ...`/`.ant-table-custom-column .ant-table-fixed .ant-table-row` rules select it to lay out `nzCustomColumn`'s flex rows under v6). The classes table's `renderedPrefixes` dependencies render (checkbox/radio/dropdown/pagination/spin's own structural and v4-compat classes) are not repeated here: each owner's own `_<dir>_comment` already explains them, and `allowlistFor` credits table with each owner's entries for its prefix.
_checkbox_comment: antd-emits: -group-rtl, -rtl (antd's own component emits the -rtl variants), -wrapper-checked, -wrapper-in-form-item (antd adds these inside Form.Item / when checked; v6 CSS never styles them). v4-compat: -group-item (v4-only structural hook on a grouped checkbox; no v6 counterpart). v4-compat (patch hook): -inner (v6 draws the box on `.ant-checkbox` itself; style/v6/patch.css mirrors those rules onto -inner, so removing it needs a patch rewrite).
_color-picker_comment: antd-emits: -handler-sm (@rc-component/color-picker's own Handler.js emits `${prefixCls}-handler-sm` for size='small'; v6's picker.js CSS has no rule for it, confirmed against the extracted CSS), -panel-disabled (@rc-component/color-picker's own ColorPicker.js emits `${prefixCls}-panel-disabled` on its panel wrapper; v6 CSS never styles it). v4-compat: -disabled (v4-only host-level disabled styling; v6 puts the disabled look on `.ant-color-picker-trigger-disabled` instead, which is added alongside), -title, -title-content (v4-only header text row; antd v6 removed the `title` concept entirely, no counterpart), -inline-lg, -inline-sm (v4-only swatch-sizing variants; v6 sizes the swatch through the trigger's own `-lg`/`-sm` modifier instead, which ng-zorro already applies to the same trigger element), -slider-alpha (v4-only conic-gradient background variant on the alpha slider; no v6 counterpart, the checker background now comes from `.ant-color-picker-slider` itself), -slider-hue (runtime modifier built from `'ant-color-picker-slider-' + type`; no stylesheet, v4 or v6, ever targets the hue variant). v4-compat (patch hook): -inline (style/v6/patch.css selects it for `display: inline-block`, since v6 has no host wrapper distinct from the trigger), -transform (style/v6/patch.css mirrors rc-component/color-picker's Transform.js inline `position`/`z-index`), -gradient (style/v6/patch.css keeps v4's absolute-fill rail rule; v6 replaced this element with antd's own Slider component and has no CSS for it), -presets-wrapper (style/v6/patch.css keeps v4's scroll-container rule; antd's ColorPresets.js renders `.ant-color-picker-presets` with no such wrapper). The ant-input-number-*, ant-select-* and ant-popover-* classes color-format.component.ts and the trigger's popover render are not repeated here: input-number's, select's and popover's own `_<dir>_comment`s already explain every one of them, and `allowlistFor` credits color-picker with each owner's entries for its `renderedPrefixes`.
_radio_comment: antd-emits: -button-checked, -button-disabled, -button-input (rc-checkbox's Checkbox.js renders `span.{prefixCls}[-checked][-disabled] > input.{prefixCls}-input` with prefixCls `ant-radio-button` in button mode, so these three are genuinely emitted unstyled), -button-wrapper-rtl, -wrapper-checked, -wrapper-in-form-item (antd's own component emits them; v6 CSS never styles them). v4-compat (patch hook): -inner (rc-checkbox never renders an inner span; it is an ng-zorro-only structural element. v6 draws the dot on `.ant-radio` itself, so style/v6/patch.css mirrors those rules onto -inner, and removing it needs a patch rewrite). v4-compat: -button-inner (same ng-zorro-only structural element for the button variant, but style/v6/patch.css never selects it — the pill's appearance comes entirely from `.ant-radio-button-wrapper`'s own background/border, so removing it needs no patch change).
_result_comment: v4-compat: -content (next to -body). antd-emits: -403, -404, -500 (exception-status root classes; v6 renders the SVG illustration without styling them).
_alert_comment: v4-compat: -action (next to -actions), -content (next to -section), -message (next to -title), -closable (no v6 rule or replacement). nz-only: -marquee, -marquee-pause-on-hover, -marquee-track (ng-zorro's looping banner, styled by the patch). antd-emits: -no-icon.
_tooltip_comment: antd-emits: -open (the trigger's visibility class). scan-artefact: ant-zoom-big-fast (the `_animationPrefix` literal; only the -enter/-leave variants built from it are rendered, and v6's motion CSS styles those).
_transfer_comment: v4-compat: -list (replacement: ant-transfer-section, added alongside on the same element), -operation (replacement: ant-transfer-actions, added alongside on the same element), -list-body-customize-wrapper (antd v6's own Section.js still renders this div at the same class name, but v6 CSS has no rule for it, so no v6 counterpart), -list-body-with-search (ng-zorro-only modifier on -list-body; v6 never emits it and no stylesheet styles it, no v6 counterpart), -list-header-selected (v6's own Section.js renders an equivalent div at the same class name with no CSS rule either, no v6 counterpart), -list-with-footer (v6's own equivalent flag is -section-with-footer, which also carries no CSS rule, so no rename needed, no v6 counterpart). Not emitted: -content-item-checked and -content-show-remove, which v4 styles too; style/v6/patch.css keys antd's rules for them onto the checked checkbox and onto rows without a checkbox. The ant-checkbox-inner, ant-checkbox-wrapper-checked and ant-input-affix-wrapper-outlined classes the header checkbox and search box render (verbatim checkbox/input DOM under the transfer prefix) are not repeated here: checkbox's and input's own `_checkbox_comment`/`_input_comment` already explain them, and `allowlistFor` credits transfer with each owner's entries for its `renderedPrefixes`.
_tree_comment: antd-emits (verified against node_modules/@rc-component/tree/es/TreeNode.js and node_modules/antd/es/tree/Tree.js; absent from manifest.json's tree.classes): -icon-hide (Tree.js's `${prefixCls}-icon-hide` when `!showIcon`), -indent-unit-start (Indent.js's `${baseClassName}-start` for a start-of-row indent unit), -node-content-wrapper-open/-close (TreeNode.js's `${wrapClass}-${nodeState}`), -treenode-checkbox-checked/-indeterminate/-loading and -treenode-switcher-open/-close (TreeNode.js's own className builders). v4-compat (patch hook): -checkbox-inner (v6 draws the checkbox box on `.ant-tree-checkbox` itself, the same shape as checkbox/radio/cascader; style/v6/patch.css mirrors it onto -inner with the tree prefix). _badge_comment: v4-compat: ant-ribbon-text (replacement: ant-ribbon-content, added alongside on the same span — antd v6's Ribbon.js renders the text span as `${prefixCls}-content`, not `-text`; compiled v4 CSS still styles .ant-ribbon-text). ant-badge-status-<preset colour> (the 13 names in preset-colors.ts; runtime template literal, badge.component.ts/badge-sup.component.ts): replacement ant-badge-color-<colour>, added alongside on the same element -- the compiled v4 CSS styles `.ant-badge-status-<colour>` directly and there is no `.ant-badge-color-*` rule in v4, and the inline background-color that would otherwise carry a preset colour is intentionally omitted for it (mergedStyle), so dropping the v4 class would leave a preset-coloured badge with no background at all under the default stylesheet.
_qr-code_comment: v4-compat: ant-qrcode-border (replacement: ant-qrcode-borderless, added alongside on the inverted !nzBordered() condition; node_modules/antd/es/qr-code/index.js flips the default to bordered and opts OUT with -borderless, while v4's -border opts IN to the same border; compiled v4 CSS still styles .ant-qrcode-border). ant-qrcode-mask (replacement: ant-qrcode-cover, added alongside on the same element; antd v6's QrcodeStatus.js/index.js wrap the status content in `${prefixCls}-cover`, not `-mask`; compiled v4 CSS still styles .ant-qrcode-mask). ant-qrcode-icon is left alone, unmapped to any category: grepping node_modules/antd/es/qr-code/*.js and @rc-component/qrcode shows antd's real QRCode component never emits this class itself (the v6 CSS rule for it is an unrelated leak from the extraction), so it is neither emitted nor added.
_empty_comment: v4-compat (patch hook): the 12 ant-empty-img-* classes (empty.js/simple.js element+condition: the 12 static class names on partial/default.ts and partial/simple.ts svg shapes) have no v6 CSS rule at all (antd 6 colours these shapes via inline styles resolved from theme tokens in React, not CSS classes); compiled v4 CSS still styles every one of them (hex fills), so style/v6/patch.css re-targets the same literal class names with the equivalent v6 token mapping (empty.js/simple.js shadowColor/borderColor/panelBgColor/detailColor/iconColor/contentColor) to keep the illustrations visible under the v6 theme. nz-only: nz-empty-rtl is a marker class (empty.component.ts host binding on Directionality) mirroring antd 6 own ant-empty-rtl state hook (Empty/index.js clsx condition direction === rtl) which v6 CSS itself does not style (ant-empty uses only logical properties); the literal antd class name ant-empty-rtl is not emitted because compiled v4 CSS already has a .ant-empty-rtl{direction:rtl} rule ng-zorro never previously reached (v4-rule-guard would flag it), so a differently-named, unstyled-under-v6 marker is used instead with no patch rule (matching its null visual effect in real antd 6). nz-only: nz-empty-simple (empty.component.ts host binding, nzNotFoundImage === 'simple') is a v4-inert hook standing in for antd's literal ant-empty-normal class on the public API path -- compiled v4 CSS already styles ant-empty-normal and ng-zorro never emitted it for a bare nzNotFoundImage="simple" caller before, so emitting the literal class now would newly change v4's existing rendering there (confirmed by a default-theme capture of the simple demo); style/v6/patch.css mirrors the same v6 sizing/colour onto this hook instead.
_list_comment: antd-emits: ant-list-rtl (index.js clsx condition direction === rtl on the root div, matching the pre-existing [class.ant-list-rtl] host binding in list.component.ts exactly); v6 CSS has no dedicated rule for it (the list stylesheet uses only logical properties, e.g. margin-inline-start, so no explicit rtl override is needed). The ant-spin-* class list's own nz-spin loading wrapper renders is not repeated here: spin's own `_spin_comment` already explains it, and `allowlistFor` credits list with spin's entries for the `ant-spin` prefix.
_avatar_comment: v4-compat (no v6 counterpart): ant-avatar-circle (avatar.component.ts's `[class.ant-avatar-circle]` host binding on the default `nzShape === 'circle'`; antd 6's Avatar.js clsx still adds `${prefixCls}-${mergedShape}`, i.e. the literal class is genuinely emitted by real antd 6 too, but v6 CSS draws the circle as `.ant-avatar`'s own `border-radius: 50%` base rule and has no `.ant-avatar-circle` selector at all -- confirmed against the raw v6 CSS extraction and manifest.json's avatar.classes), ant-avatar-string (avatar.component.ts's `<span class="ant-avatar-string">`; Avatar.js renders the same class on its text span, but v6 positions/scales it entirely via the inline styles its ResizeObserver callback sets -- the same technique avatar.component.ts's own calcStringSize already uses -- and v6 CSS has no `.ant-avatar-string` rule).
_image_comment: v4-compat: ant-image-preview-root (image-preview.component.ts host class; v6's rc-component/image Preview.js puts the prefixCls class -- ant-image-preview, already emitted here -- directly on the motion wrapper div, with no separate -root wrapper, so -root has no v6 counterpart and stays as the component's own host identifier), ant-image-preview-wrap (no v6 counterpart -- v6's Preview.js has one wrapper div, not a -wrap plus a -preview; -wrap keeps the fixed full-viewport box v4 needs for its own top-bar-and-corner-buttons layout), ant-image-preview-content and ant-image-preview-img-wrapper (no v6 counterpart -- Preview.js nests the directly in -body with no intermediate wrappers; ng-zorro keeps both for the CDK drag host and v4's own transform transition). v4-compat (replacement: ant-image-preview-footer, added alongside on the same element): ant-image-preview-operations-wrapper. v4-compat (replacement: ant-image-preview-actions, added alongside on the same element): ant-image-preview-operations. v4-compat (replacement: ant-image-preview-actions-action for the six non-close operations, ant-image-preview-close for the close operation, both added alongside on the same li): ant-image-preview-operations-operation. v4-compat (replacement: ant-image-preview-actions-action-disabled, added alongside): ant-image-preview-operations-operation-disabled. v4-compat (no v6 counterpart -- Footer.js's progressNode carries only ant-image-preview-progress, itself unstyled by v6 CSS, so the v4 progress class is kept without a v6 sibling): ant-image-preview-operations-progress. v4-compat (no v6 counterpart -- v6 does not class the icon inside an action button): ant-image-preview-operations-icon. v4-compat (replacement: ant-image-preview-switch-prev and ant-image-preview-switch-disabled respectively, added alongside on the same div): ant-image-preview-switch-left, ant-image-preview-switch-left-disabled. v4-compat (replacement: ant-image-preview-switch-next and ant-image-preview-switch-disabled respectively, added alongside on the same div): ant-image-preview-switch-right, ant-image-preview-switch-right-disabled. antd-emits (unstyled): ant-image-preview-actions-action-flipX/-flipY/-rotateLeft/-rotateRight/-zoomIn/-zoomOut (@rc-component/image es/Preview/Footer.js renderOperation: `clsx(actionCls, \`${actionCls}-${type}\`, ...)` on every action button; v6 CSS has no per-type rule, only the bare .ant-image-preview-actions-action, already emitted and styled -- kept as the same runtime-built-looking but here template-bound class pair antd itself emits). v4-compat (no v6 counterpart -- real antd 6 uses the generic `ant-fade-*` CSS-transition motion from `@rc-component/motion`'s `CSSMotion`, not a keyframe pair): ant-image-preview-fade-motion-enter, ant-image-preview-fade-motion-leave (image-preview-ref.ts's own `generateClassName('ant-image-preview', 'fade-motion-enter'/'-leave')`, toggled to drive the v4 `antFadeIn`/`antFadeOut` keyframe animation and the `animationend`-based close detection; compiled v4 CSS already styles both literal names, confirmed in publish/ng-zorro-antd.css).
_menu_comment: antd-emits: ant-menu-submenu-vertical / ant-menu-submenu-horizontal (@rc-component/menu/es/SubMenu/index.js:260 always adds `${subMenuPrefixCls}-${mode}` to the submenu <li>, matching submenu.component.ts's host bindings; v6 CSS has no rule for either, and -horizontal is also styled by the compiled v4 stylesheet, so it stays for v4). antd-emits (dropdown's menu vocabulary, rendered by [nz-menu]/[nz-menu-item]/[nz-submenu]/[nz-menu-group] when hosted in nz-dropdown-menu; `ant-dropdown` in renderedPrefixes credits the rest of that vocabulary to dropdown's styled classes and allowlist, and dropdown's extracted CSS has no rule for these): ant-dropdown-menu-dark (antd/es/menu/menu.js:121 `${prefixCls}-${theme}` with Dropdown's prefixCls `ant-dropdown-menu`), ant-dropdown-menu-horizontal / -inline (@rc-component/menu/es/Menu.js:351 `${prefixCls}-${internalMode}`; -vertical is styled), ant-dropdown-menu-inline-collapsed (Menu.js:352), ant-dropdown-menu-item-group (MenuItemGroup.js:27), ant-dropdown-menu-submenu-open / -active / -horizontal / -inline (SubMenu/index.js:260-262). Not emitted: ant-menu-item-icon (the compiled v4 stylesheet styles it; nz-icon carries .anticon instead: the display of v6's `.ant-menu .ant-menu-item .ant-menu-item-icon` rule is mirrored onto `.anticon` in style/v6/patch.css, its remaining declarations equal the global .anticon rule's, and the -item-icon-only `+ .ant-menu-title-content-with-extra` rule needs `extra`, which ng-zorro has no input for), ant-menu-item-only-child (v4-styled; its v6 rules only zero the margin of a direct-child icon, and ng-zorro projects item icons inside .ant-menu-title-content), ant-menu-item-active / ant-menu-item-open / ant-menu-selected / ant-menu-popup (v4-styled; antd 6.6.5 and @rc-component/menu never emit -item-open, -selected or -popup, and -item-active is rc-menu's keyboard/hover state whose v6 rules each pair it with :hover or -submenu-active), ant-menu-hidden (v4-styled; ng-zorro's inline list hides with ant-menu-submenu-hidden, styled the same by both stylesheets), ant-menu-overflow (v4-styled; rc-overflow's responsive '...' indicator, which ng-zorro's horizontal menu does not have, so its items keep wrapping instead of overflowing), ant-menu-item-divider (v4-styled; style/v6/patch.css mirrors its rule onto the ant-dropdown-menu-item-divider that menu-divider.directive.ts renders), ant-menu-submenu-placement-rightTop / -leftTop / -bottomLeft / ... (v4 styles -placement-rightTop; ng-zorro keeps v4's coarse -placement-right / -left / -bottom and style/v6/patch.css mirrors v6's placement padding onto them), ant-menu-inline-collapsed-noicon (antd's first-letter label for an icon-less first-level item when collapsed, a DOM element ng-zorro does not render), ant-menu-inline-collapsed-tooltip (the collapsed item's tooltip is composed by the user with nz-tooltip; [nz-menu-item] renders none), ant-menu-submenu-expand-icon (only for a custom expandIcon), ant-menu-item-divider-dashed (MenuDivider `dashed`), ant-menu-item-label / ant-menu-item-extra / ant-menu-title-content-with-extra (only for an `items` entry with `extra`; @rc-component/menu/es/utils/nodeUtil.js:67-69, antd/es/menu/MenuItem.js:45), all three without an ng-zorro input (docs/v6-api-gaps.md).
